findings.evidence: `LocalCompactness.lean:111` `theorem W1p.isCompactOperator_valueL_restrictL (hp : p ≠ ∞) (hVc …) (hVO : closure V ⊆ Omega)`. The proof's inputs `exists_dist_preciseRepresentative_le` (`InteriorMorrey.lean:131`, `∀ {Omega}` with `closedBall x (2*dist x y) ⊆ Omega`) and `continuousOn_preciseRepresentative` (`InteriorMorrey.lean:205`, any `Omega`) already work at that level. Equicontinuity on compact `K ⊆ Omega` follows by the same argument used at `InteriorMorrey.lean:251` (`exists_cthickening_subset_open`).
findings.fix: State it for `{Omega V : Opens E} (hVc : IsCompact (closure (V : Set E))) (hVO : closure (V : Set E) ⊆ Omega)` with `W1p.restrictL (… hVO)`, as in `LocalCompactness.lean:111`. Better still, merge it into `isCompactOperator_valueL_restrictL` without the `hp : p ≠ ∞` hypothesis. The Lipschitz-domain caller then needs no `by_cases`.
findings.issue: `isCompactOperator_valueL_restrictL_top` covers only restriction from `W1p mu ⊤ ∞`. The finite-p sibling covers any `Omega` with `V` having compact closure inside it, so interior endpoint compactness is missing and the two theorems have mismatched signatures.

findings.evidence: Line 223 states `(u : W1p mu ⊤ ∞) (x : E)`. Compare the sibling statements at `InteriorMorrey.lean:88, 131, 187, 205, 244, 282`, which are all `{Omega : Opens E}`.
findings.fix: Generalize to `{Omega : Opens E} (u : W1p mu Omega ∞) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ Omega) : ‖preciseRepresentative mu (W1p.value u) x‖ ≤ ‖W1p.value u‖`. Use `continuousOn_preciseRepresentative` together with the a.e. bound on `mu.restrict Omega`; since `Omega` is open, every neighbourhood of `x` meets `Omega` in positive measure.
findings.issue: `W1p.norm_preciseRepresentative_le` is stated only for `u : W1p mu ⊤ ∞`. Every other lemma in this file quantifies over `{Omega : Opens E}`, and the density/closedness argument works just as well at points of an open `Omega`.

findings.evidence: Line 51: `∃ f : W1p mu ⊤ ∞ → K →ᵇ ℝ`. Line 78 uses `subset_univ _` only to discharge the `closedBall … ⊆ Omega` premise of `exists_dist_preciseRepresentative_le`.
findings.fix: Parametrize it by `{Omega : Opens E}` and a compact `K ⊆ Omega`, using the generalized pointwise bound and the `cthickening` radius for the equicontinuity step.
findings.issue: The private Arzelà–Ascoli lemma `isCompact_closure_preciseRepresentative_unitBall` also fixes `W1p mu ⊤ ∞`, which forces the public theorem down to the whole-space case.

summary: The new endpoint compactness theorem and its pointwise bound only cover `Omega = ⊤`, while the finite-p sibling `isCompactOperator_valueL_restrictL` and every Morrey lemma they use work for arbitrary `Omega`. Generalizing them gives one local Rellich theorem for all `1 ≤ p ≤ ∞` and removes the `by_cases` split.
